sloka: आदिष्टा वानरेन्द्रास्तु सुग्रीवेण महात्मना।आसन्नद्वारमासाद्य युध्यध्वं प्लवगर्षभाः ।। ६.७५.४१ ।।
transliteration: ādiṣṭā vānarendrāstu sugrīveṇa mahātmanā।āsannadvāramāsādya yudhyadhvaṁ plavagarṣabhāḥ ।। 6.75.41 ।।

translations.english: Seeing Rama's arrows on the highrise mansions and houses, the Rakshasa leaders started preparing for comb at out of fear.
